## The mountainous Rhön region...

...is situated at the very centre of Germany, along Hessen's borders with Thuringia and Bavaria. The Rhön UNESCO Biosphere Reserve envelops the region, spilling into these neighbouring states.

Separated from the volcanic region of [Vogelsberg](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/where-to-go/regions/vogelsberg) by the Fulda Valley and its winding river, the region's largely woodless volcanic mountains and valleys offer magnificent panoramic views, unique flora and fauna and seemingly endless opportunities for bracing outdoor activities.

The Rhön is one of Germany's top **hiking** destinations, with over 6,000 km of [well-signposted trails](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/explore-nature/active-holidays/hikingin-hessen/hiking-in-the-rhon) including 25 certified circular trails as well as a 180 km premium route. Cyclists will discover a wealth of [biking trails](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/explore-nature/active-holidays/cycling-in-hessen), that weave through the region's lush mountains and valleys. The lakes and rivers here offer plentiful opportunities for canoeing and swimming; back on land, you can take your pick from golfing, climbing, horse riding and even llama trekking.

During the warmer months, head up to the region's highest mountain, the Wasserkuppe, to take to the skies on a para- or hang glide or hurtle back down the slopes on a 700m summer toboggan run. Come winter, go to the same spot to indulge in **winter sports** such as snowkiting and downhill or cross-country skiing.

This region isn't just about the great outdoors, however: it has more than its fair share of **cultural highlights**, too. The town of Bad Hersfeld boasts some 200 listed medieval buildings as well as historic monastry ruins, and in [Fulda](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/where-to-go/towns-and-cities/fulda), you'll find gorgeous Baroque architecture and a stunning cathedral built on the burial site of St Boniface. There are countless annual festivals and events to attend, from folk festivals, carnival celebrations and open-air concerts to Bad Kissingen's international classical music festival.

After all this activity, embrace some **rest and relaxation**. The Rhön has been a wellness destination for centuries and is home to eight spa towns offering a wealth of health and beauty treatments and premium pampering packages at their various spa hotels and thermal baths. If you enjoy your food and drink, you're in the right place for that, too: locals take great pride in their [regional specialties](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/inspiration/food-and-drink), from trout and lamb to bread and beer, and you'll find the locals to be hospitable hosts. Finally, with accommodation options ranging from farmstays, guesthouses and cosy holiday cottages to your own tent or caravan or a stylish hotel, you're sure to find the perfect place for a well-earned, good night's sleep.

## Privacy Notice

We use cookies and other technologies

Various cookies are used on our website: technical, for marketing purposes and those for analysis purposes, as well as cookies for displaying videos and social media feeds. In principle, you can also visit our website without setting cookies. The technically necessary cookies are excluded from this. You have a right of withdrawal at any time. You can find more information about cookies in our [privacy policy](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/privacy-policy?cookieconsent=hide). By clicking "Activate all" you agree that we set the aforementioned cookies for marketing and analysis purposes as well as for the display of videos and social media feeds.

## Privacy Settings

You can adjust your data protection and privacy settings here. Further information can be found in our [Privacy Policy](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/privacy-policy?cookieconsent=hide).

### Necessary cookies

Off1

Technically necessary cookies help to make a website usable by enabling basic functions such as page navigation and access to secure areas of the website. The website cannot function properly without these cookies.

Cookies

- We only set a cookie, which stores the state of the selection made in the cookie banner.

**Cookie:** lll-cookieconsent-status, lll-cookieconsent-preferences

**Expiration:** 12 month

**Provider:** [HA Hessen Tourismus](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/privacy-policy/)

- We use your browser's LocalStorage to save the bookmarks list, travel planner and search history in order to save marked entries and make suggestions in the search.

**Cookie:** HT-Bookmarks, HT-Travelplanner, HT-SearchHistory

**Expiration:** LocalStorage

**Provider:** [HA Hessen Tourismus](https://en.hessen-tourismus.de/privacy-policy/)


### Performance

Off1

With these cookies the range of our own offer can be measured. Among other things, cookies enable us to track which website was visited before accessing our website and how our website was used. We use this data, among other things, to optimize our website by evaluating the campaigns we have carried out.

Cookies

- Matomo collects anonymous statistics about the behavior of users on the website (number of visits, etc.).

**Cookie:** \_pk\_id, \_pk\_ses, MATOMO\_SESSID

**Expiration:** 13 months, 30 minutes, Session

**Provider:** [Matomo](https://matomo.org/privacy-policy)


### External Embeds

Off1

This website may display content and media from external sites such as YouTube. Cookies from external sites are stored in the process.

Cookies

- We use the Google service "YouTube", which provides media such as videos and also analyzes user behavior.

**Cookie:** 1P\_Jar, AEC, CONSENT, DV, NID

**Expiration:** 1 month, 6 months, 2 years, 7 minutes, 6 months

**Provider:** [Google Ireland Ltd.](https://policies.google.com/privacy?hl=en&gl=en)
